requirements.description: Candidate case filings and SEC metadata: initial Schedule 13E-3 filings in the paper's Jan 1998–May 9 2005 filing window, including Schedule TO documents that contain the Schedule 13E-3 information after Jan 24 2000. This requirement covers the candidate filing universe and the documents needed to screen transaction type.

required_coverage.population: All public SEC electronic SC 13E-3 and qualifying combined Schedule TO filings from Jan 1998 through May 9 2005.
required_coverage.detail: 2005 is bounded at May 9. This is the initial filing-date window only; actual transaction-announcement dates are not substituted for filing dates. The paper screens foreign issuer/acquiror, bankruptcy and asset-sale/liquidation cases.

routes.mapping_notes: Filter EDGAR index entries for initial SC 13E-3 and qualifying Schedule TO documents; parse filed-by and subject-company details. Filing date is the sample-screen date, not assumed to be the transaction announcement date.
routes.coverage_notes: EDGAR official indexes cover public electronic submissions from 1994Q3, including the required filing years, and expose form/CIK/date/file fields. SEC notes some filings remain paper and inaccessible via EDGAR; no paper-level case completeness is established. Target versus filing-party CIK and exact initial/TO mapping need review.

requirements.unresolved_reason: Official EDGAR indexes establish electronic submissions and filing metadata, but the SEC notes paper filings that are not accessible in EDGAR. The source does not establish whether this case population includes any such records or give an alternate route; no absence or access-block conclusion is made.

requirements.description: Subsequent Form 15/Form 25 filings used to establish that a candidate going-private deal was completed.

required_coverage.population: Each candidate issuer/subject firm in the initial 1998–May 2005 Schedule 13E-3/Schedule TO filing universe.
required_coverage.detail: The paper says to retrieve a subsequent Form 15 or Form 25 but does not bound how long after the initial filing to search.

routes.mapping_notes: Search each initial candidate's later EDGAR filings for Form 15 or Form 25 and connect the completion record to the subject company.
routes.coverage_notes: The paper requires a subsequent Form 15/25 but gives no last date for that follow-up search. The SEC route covers EDGAR submissions only, and the subject-company CIK must be linked to the initial filing.

requirements.unresolved_reason: Follow-up end date and exact linkage of termination filings to initial transactions are not stated; paper-filing coverage is also not established.

requirements.description: Exact 237 treated-firm membership in Table 8 column (1), including all case-level sample screens.

required_coverage.population: 237 going-private firms in the pooled Table 8 column (1) matched sample.
required_coverage.detail: Paper gives the 470 candidate transactions and a Table 2 sequence ending at 237 cases with complete accounting and CRSP return data, then Table 8 uses 237 going-private cases plus 237 controls. The actual Table 8 case membership and its relationship to the announcement-return filter are not explicitly stated.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The link from Table 2's 237 cases selected partly on CRSP announcement-return availability to Table 8's 237 treated firms is not made explicit; exact treated identities for the frozen fit cannot be inferred from the reported counts.

requirements.description: Eligible non-going-private control universe, one-to-one matched control assignments and the matched-set identifier required for conditional logit.

required_coverage.population: 237 non-going-private controls matched to the 237 treated cases in Table 8 column (1).
required_coverage.detail: The paper reports prior-fiscal-year market value, four-digit SIC with three-/two-digit fallback, and |ln(MV treated)-ln(MV control)| < ln(4), using natural logs. It does not report the candidate control universe, replacement/tie rules, all eligibility/data filters, the covariate date for a control, or an explicit conditional-logit group identifier.

requirements.unresolved_reason: A specific control population and exact matching/strata construction are not reported. Without those, the 237 controls and conditional-logit sets cannot be independently identified, even though the matching inputs and caliper are partly described.

requirements.description: Manager/director ownership percentage for treated and matched-control firms, using the most recent SEC filing before the going-private announcement.

required_coverage.population: Going-private firms and their 237 non-going-private controls in the full matched sample.
required_coverage.detail: No maximum lookback from announcement to prior filing is stated; exact event dates, control-firm anchor, aggregation of managers/directors and denominator/security scope are not specified.

fields: full filing text and ownership disclosures; form type, CIK, date filed
routes.mapping_notes: The paper uses manager/director ownership from the most recent filing before a going-private announcement. SEC filing text may include ownership exhibits and proxy materials; the exact manager/director aggregation, denominator, included securities, and control-firm reference date are not specified.
routes.coverage_notes: No maximum prior-filing lookback is reported; the actual announcement date is not equated with the initial Schedule 13E-3 filing. SEC also notes that some filings are paper and inaccessible in EDGAR. No historical ownership population confirmation is supplied.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The most-recent-prior filing rule has no bounded history and the exact percent aggregation and control date anchor are missing; SEC public coverage is not complete for paper filings.

requirements.description: Annual fiscal accounting inputs for the prior-year financial predictors and matching design: assets, liabilities, sales, operating income before depreciation, income taxes/deferred taxes, dividends, book equity, and return-on-assets candidate components.

required_coverage.population: 237 treated firms and 237 matched controls in the pooled Table 8 full sample.
required_coverage.detail: The source anchors annual values to the year before a going-private announcement and matching market value to the fiscal year before announcement. Sample filing dates are Jan 1998–May 9 2005, but announcement-to-filing timing and fiscal-year label/end alignment are unspecified. SalesGr needs an additional prior fiscal-year sales observation; Tax/FCF footnote 17 and denominator conflict can require additional history.

routes.mapping_notes: Catalog labels support candidate annual raw inputs for assets, liabilities, sales, operating income before depreciation, income taxes/deferred taxes, dividends, equity, net-income candidates, and historical SIC. The article does not give Compustat item names for Table 8's formula; footnote 17 gives item numbers with a conflicting FCF definition. ROA and SalesGr are underdefined. No numeric/name resemblance is used to map item numbers. The reported fiscal-year and record filters are not specified.
routes.coverage_notes: Probe verifies exact live fields and read access only. There is no coordinator coverage confirmation for the 1998–2005 event-linked target/control population or the earlier fiscal records required by SalesGr and footnote 17. Catalog observation counts and sampled rows are not coverage proof.

requirements.unresolved_reason: Live fields and access are verified, but no coordinator coverage confirmation establishes all target/control firms and the requisite earlier fiscal years. ROA, SalesGr, FCF and Tax mappings/transformations and record-selection filters remain unresolved.

requirements.description: Monthly CRSP price, share volume and shares outstanding used for average share turnover and prior-fiscal-year market value of equity; historical SIC is a candidate matching field.

required_coverage.population: Treated and matched-control securities during the year before each case announcement; prior-fiscal-year market-value observations for matching.
required_coverage.detail: Paper reports average monthly share turnover and share volume/shares outstanding, and matches using prior-fiscal-year market value. It does not define units, averaging order, exact event window endpoints, security selection, price date relative to fiscal year, or SIC source/date.

routes.mapping_notes: Fields are candidate inputs for monthly volume, shares outstanding, price, historical security ID and SIC. Paper-defined turnover is monthly share volume divided by shares outstanding, but unit conversions, monthly averaging order, price/market-value date, security choice, and SIC source are not reported. The paper does not identify a matching-data product; this route is a field-access candidate only.
routes.coverage_notes: Exact local fields are readable, but no coordinator coverage confirmation covers the announcement-linked 12-month windows and all matched targets/controls. A sample date or catalog count is not coverage evidence.

requirements.unresolved_reason: Probe proves exact columns/read access only. No coordinator coverage confirmation establishes the target/control histories; units, dates, and identifier/security selection are unverified.

requirements.description: Date-valid mapping from SEC filing subject/filer identity to Compustat GVKEY for treated and control firms.

required_coverage.population: Target and matched-control firms with SEC filings in the event and pre-event periods.
required_coverage.detail: Paper does not name the CIK-to-Compustat crosswalk or its filtering/date conventions. A candidate local WRDSSEC historical link includes SEC and link start/end fields.

routes.mapping_notes: This is a candidate historical CIK-GVKEY bridge for SEC filers to Compustat firms. The article does not report its linkage source or acceptance/date rules; SEC filer CIK versus subject-company identity must be checked for each filing.
routes.coverage_notes: The exact link and interval columns are probe-verified, but historical event/population coverage and issuer/subject link validity are not coordinator-confirmed.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The local crosswalk's fields are readable, but historical population coverage, issuer-versus-subject CIK selection and event-date-valid link criteria are not coordinator-confirmed or specified by the paper.

requirements.description: Date-valid mapping from Compustat GVKEY to the CRSP security used for returns, monthly turnover and equity market value.

required_coverage.population: Treated and matched-control firm securities in the event-linked prior-year periods.
required_coverage.detail: A candidate local CCM link table provides GVKEY, PERMNO/PERMCO, link type/primary flags and validity dates; article does not report filters or security selection.

routes.mapping_notes: Candidate historical GVKEY-to-PERMNO/PERMCO link. The link table exposes primary/type/validity fields, but the paper does not specify linkprim/linktype, used-flag, security/share-class or end-date filtering. The correct identifier is thus not asserted.
routes.coverage_notes: Probe verifies exact fields and local access only; no coordinator coverage confirmation establishes valid links for the treated and matched-control population and event years.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The exact link fields are probe-verified, but no paper criteria or coordinator coverage confirmation identifies accepted links, primary securities, or dates for this population.

requirements.description: GDP implicit price deflator used to adjust financial data to 1998 price levels.

required_coverage.frequency: annual or quarterly price-index observation; exact frequency unresolved
required_coverage.population: Fiscal-year and market-value observations for the treated and matched-control sample, including preceding fiscal observations used in growth/denominator calculations.
required_coverage.detail: Article states that all data are price-level adjusted with GDP deflator and 1998 base. Current BEA Table 1.1.9 is a public series; the paper does not say whether annual or quarterly values align to fiscal-year/market dates. Current index vintage must be rebased to 1998 and differs from the paper-era vintage.

routes.source_name: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis NIPA GDP implicit price deflator
fields: NIPA Table 1.1.9, line 1: Gross domestic product implicit price deflator
routes.mapping_notes: BEA NIPA Table 1.1.9 is the official GDP implicit price deflator. The paper uses a 1998 base; current table values are on a later index base and can be rebased to 1998. The article does not state annual-versus-quarterly or fiscal-year/date assignment for each financial value, and BEA historical estimates are revised.
routes.coverage_notes: Official BEA table and definition were verified, but exact annual/quarter alignment and required historical endpoints are not bounded because the paper anchors to announcement dates and fiscal-year prior observations without defining their relation to initial filing dates.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The source series is identified, but exact historical endpoints and fiscal/calendar period alignment cannot be fixed because announcement dates and prior-fiscal-year mapping are not bounded relative to the initial filing window.

variable_coverage.construction: Derived case/control indicator: 1 for qualified going-private firms and 0 for matched controls. Exact Table 8 case/control membership and matched-set IDs remain unresolved; see sampling requirements.

Manager/director ownership percentage from each firm's most recent SEC filing before the going-private announcement. Aggregate persons/classes and denominator are not specified; controls have no own going-private announcement date.

Average monthly share turnover, with the paper describing share volume divided by shares outstanding in the year before the announcement. Monthly volume/shares units, ratio averaging order, and exact interval are unresolved.

Book-to-market = book assets / (book assets - book equity + market value of equity), measured in the year before announcement. Equity field, market-value date and fiscal alignment are not stated; paper price-adjusts financial data to 1998.

Prior-year sales growth. Requires annual sales in the prior fiscal year and a preceding fiscal-year sales observation; rate denominator, transformation and inflation adjustment timing are not reported.
Total liabilities / total assets in the year before announcement; annual-record filters and fiscal-year alignment are not specified.

Use the selected Table 8 note formula (operating income before depreciation - income tax expense + deferred taxes - preferred/common dividends) / assets. Footnote 17 instead subtracts interest, defines current tax from item 16 minus change in item 35, and uses beginning-year assets; preserve this conflict without silently substituting it.
Return on assets in the year before announcement. The paper does not specify numerator, denominator, or calculation; Compustat income/assets fields are candidates only.

Current tax expense / assets in the year before announcement. Footnote 17's current-income-tax explanation references item 16 minus change in item 35, but its field mapping/date treatment is unresolved.

design_coverage.reason: The Table 8 note identifies conditional-logit coefficients but reports no cluster level or variance correction; the parenthetical statistics are unlabeled.

No separate fixed-effect terms are reported for Table 8 column (1). Conditional-logit matched-set grouping is tracked under estimation and matching; it is not silently labeled as a separate fixed-effect specification.
No weights are reported for the Table 8 column (1) conditional-logit fit.

implementation_issues.description: The Table 8 column (1) sample is reported as N=474 (237 cases and 237 controls), while Table 2's 237-case endpoint is described as requiring complete accounting and CRSP announcement-return data. The paper does not explicitly connect Table 8 case membership to that return-based screen, so the exact frozen case set is not identified by the text.

The eligible control-firm population, replacement and tie rules, all eligibility/missing-data screens, the control covariate date, and the explicit conditional-logit group ID are unreported. The source gives SIC fallback and a natural-log market-value caliper but these do not uniquely generate 237 controls or strata.

The reported sample period is an initial filing-date window, but predictor timing is relative to a going-private announcement and financial inputs are annual/fiscal. Announcement-to-filing offsets, prior-year fiscal label/end alignment, and the control-firm reference date are not specified.

The selected Table 8 FCF note uses (OIBD less tax expense plus deferred taxes less dividends)/assets; footnote 17 instead subtracts interest, defines current tax as item 16 less the change in item 35, and uses beginning-of-year assets. The source conflict is retained; the reported construction cannot be fully reconciled.
ROA is defined only as return on assets; no numerator, denominator, average-assets endpoints, or exact fiscal period is reported.

SalesGr is labeled prior-year sales growth but its formula, denominator, scaling and inflation-adjustment order are not specified. At least one additional prior fiscal-year sales observation is needed beyond the prior-year level.
Turnover is average monthly share turnover, with share volume divided by shares outstanding, but the averaging order, CRSP share units/conversion and exact prior-year monthly window are unspecified.

Table 8 parenthetical statistics are not identified as t-statistics, standard errors or another statistic, and no standard-error/variance correction or clustering is reported; coefficient inference cannot be matched exactly.

Historical CIK-to-GVKEY and GVKEY-to-PERMNO links are available as candidate tables, but the paper does not state link filters, primary security selection, issuer-versus-subject CIK choice, or validity-date rules; local field probes do not establish link coverage.

Reconstruction requires reviewing Schedule 13E-3/Schedule TO documents, Form 15/25 follow-ups and related proxy filings to screen completion and the paper's foreign-company, bankruptcy and asset-sale/liquidation exclusions; manager/director ownership also requires document-level extraction.

Current local Compustat/CRSP snapshots and current BEA historical estimates may differ from study-era data; the BEA series is now indexed to a later base and would be rebased to 1998. Preserve current-vintage differences in any reconstruction.

review_notes: Only Table 8 column (1) is included. The SOX return predictors in columns (3)–(5) belong to later post-SOX fits and are not added.
The work item's baseline selects the Table 8 FCF note. Footnote 17's alternative expression is retained as a source conflict, not substituted.
